why: ARES lists Presto Ventures II a.s., osoba rizikového kapitálu (IČO 11678704, Praha 1), and prestoventures.com shows this entity convening its annual general meeting as the Presto Ventures Fund II vehicle.
AIN article of 23 Oct 2024 lists Bavovna among the first investments of Presto Tech Horizons, the Presto Ventures/CSG fund.
Startuprise article of 23 Oct 2024 lists Tur.ai among the first Presto Tech Horizons investments (Presto was the lead investor).
Press release of 14 May 2025 names Presto Tech Horizons as an investor in DiffuseDrive's $3.5M round.
The EUR 150M for Presto Tech Horizons is only a 'target size' (CSG release) / 'up to' 150M (e15), with no close announced, so the 180M sum includes an unraised target amount.

Fund II did reach a EUR 30M final close, but this is not the total: the earlier first fund (15 startups) and Presto Tech Horizons (about ten investments made) are closed/active vehicles of Presto that are left out, which most likely adds well over 20 %.
CzechCrunch of 23 Jun 2022 reports Presto Ventures took a significant part in GoRamp's EUR 1.5M round.
CzechCrunch of 21 Jul 2023 reports GoRamp's $3M round with Presto (repeat investor) alongside Lead Ventures, Willgrow and Startup Wise Guys.
AIN article of 23 Oct 2024 lists Tur.ai among the first Presto Tech Horizons investments.
ARES shows Purple Ventures s.r.o., IČO 05775574, Brno; purple-ventures.com footer names this entity with the same ID (member of Purple Holding).
CzechCrunch of 27 Jun 2024 names iVent Pro among the first three investments of Purple Ventures' second fund (CB Insights dates the round July 2024).
CzechCrunch of 15 Oct 2025 reports Delta Green raised EUR 2M from Credo Ventures, Tilia Impact Ventures and Purple Ventures.
Lupa (11 Mar 2026) says the second fund already holds over CZK 780M, and the first fund is EUR 15M (CZK 380M) per CzechCrunch; the sum of about 32M + 15M EUR matches 47.0M.
The 27 Jun 2024 article announces iVent Pro among the fund's first investments (CB Insights dates the round 2 Jul 2024), within two months of June 2024.

Purple Ventures did invest, but ArtMaster's round led by Purple with Gi21 was announced 13 Mar 2025 (CzechCrunch, AIN); no April 2026 round found, the Gi21 post dated 29 Apr 2026 repeats the 2025 'July launch' text.
e15 (Aug 2025) says only EUR 27M was signed 'z cílových čtyřiceti', so EUR 40M is the target size, not raised capital.
Funding.tech.eu lists a May 2024 EUR 2.2M Delta Green deal with Credo, Purple and Tilia, and CzechCrunch (Jun 2024) says the fund's very first investment came in May, alongside Tilia and Credo.
ARES shows Gi21 Capital a.s., IČO 19584229, Londýnská 2578/54 Praha; Gi21 Capital a.s. is listed at the same address as other companies of [osoba]'s Gi21 group, whose blog is on gi21capital.com.
TheSaaSNews reports Zerops's USD 2M seed in May 2026 led by Gi21 Capital.
Gi21's post of 27 Aug 2026 states Gi21 Capital invested in Hermetiq's USD 2.2M seed round, and other outlets date that round to August 2026.

Gi21 did invest in ArtMaster, but the round (led by Purple Ventures, Gi21 joined) was announced 13 Mar 2025; the Gi21 blog entry dated 29 Apr 2026 repeats the 2025 'launch in July' text and no 2026 round was found.
Gi21's blog lists 'Why We Invested in Hermetiq' dated 27 Aug 2026 and the post confirms Gi21 invested in the USD 2.2M seed round.
Gi21 invested alongside Purple Ventures, but the ArtMaster round was announced 13 Mar 2025 (CzechCrunch, AIN), not April 2026.
Gi21's post of 21 May 2026 announces its participation in FaceUp's USD 5M Series A led by Fil Rouge Capital; JIC Ventures press coverage confirms May 2026.
TheSaaSNews gives funding date May 2026 and names Gi21 Capital as lead investor of Zerops's USD 2M seed.
Gi21's blog lists the FaceUp post dated 21 May 2026 and the post says Gi21 joined the USD 5M Series A.
ARES shows MITON CZ, s.r.o., IČO 25417967, Křižíkova 148/34 Praha 8, and miton.cz/about names MITON CZ, s.r.o. and the same Křižíkova address as the Miton group's company.
AIN of 10 Mar 2025: DeepScout's round was led by startup studio Miton with EUR 200,000 upfront.
Miton's blog says MitonC invested in GTE's pre-seed and seed rounds in 2024 (GTE's pre-seed closed Q3 and seed Q4 2024).
Miton's post of 7 Jan 2026 says it led PangeAI's pre-seed round; data aggregators date the round to December 2025, within two months of January 2026.
MitonC's review post cites its tweet of 16 Jan 2025 backing GTE, the date GTE's pre-seed/seed funding was publicly announced (The Block, 16 Jan 2025).
Startbase of 15 Jul 2025 reports Aim's EUR 300,000 pre-seed from early-stage investor Miton.
CzechCrunch of 18 Nov 2024 reports Miton added an investment (minority stake) in POS Experts.
Miton's blog states that through MitonC it invested in Firefish in 2023 (CB Insights also lists a 2023 seed round); the Braiins-led seed was a later 2025 round.
Miton's about page lists Bandits among its 2025 AI investments, and press coverage reports Miton's EUR 400k investment in Bandits in late 2025.
Miton's about page lists PangeAI among its 2025 investments, and data aggregators date PangeAI's Miton-led round to December 2025.
